field_tooltip_interactive_debounce.label: Tooltip Content Hide Delay
field_tooltip_interactive_debounce.description: Determines the time in ms to debounce the Tooltip content hide handler when the cursor leaves.

field_tooltip_custom_maxwidth.label: Max Width
field_tooltip_custom_maxwidth.description: Specifies the maximum width of the tooltip. Useful to prevent it from being too horizontally wide to read.

field_tooltip_offset_skidding.label: Tooltip Horizontal Position
field_tooltip_offset_skidding.description: Tooltip horizontal distance length from element to tooltip.

field_tooltip_offset_distance.label: Tooltip Vertical Position
field_tooltip_offset_distance.description: Tooltip vertical distance length from spot to tooltip.
